knowledge: Prior platform research used this historical dataset. All results are retrospective, not genuinely unseen OOS.

rules.trend: CSI300 close above trailing 20-session SMA: 100%; otherwise 25%
rules.resonance: At least 3 of 4 indices above own trailing 20-session SMA: 100%; otherwise 25%
rules.volume: CSI300 above trailing SMA20 AND volume above trailing volume SMA20: 100%; otherwise 25%
rules.divergence: CSI300 above SMA20 AND at least 2 other indices above SMA20: 100%; otherwise 25%

execution: Close t signal, next session open rebalance using existing market_regime.simulate; no parameter search; last-bar liquidation; single-side cost 5bps, stress 10bps
split: First two thirds development, final third retrospective holdout; 60-session chronological folds, omit tail shorter than 20
comparison: buy-hold, fixed 50%, single-index trend, same-period constant exposure matching each candidate mean exposure
screen: holdout return greater than trend and matched-exposure benchmark; Sharpe greater than trend; drawdown no worse than trend; positive excess versus trend in majority of at least 3 folds; stress net excess versus trend positive
limitations: Price index proxies; no dividends, cash interest, ETF tracking, taxes or impact
Four-index confirmation is not constituent breadth
Retrospective historical reconstruction; data vendor single-source coverage
News/earnings/holdings PIT archive unverified and excluded
